messages:
Avery (People Ops): quick Q  rented a car for a client visit. i refueled once but the rental company charged a "refuel service" when i returned the car (no receipt beyond their invoice). also got a toll invoice from the rental co for a highway toll and i lost the gas station receipt earlier. what docs do we need to file?
Kai (Sales): had that happen. rental co just emailed an itemized invoice showing refuel fee + toll admin fee. i uploaded that and my card statement. finance accepted it but asked for a short note about why receipt missing.
Lian (Finance): policy: prefer original merchant receipts (gas pump receipt, toll invoice). if the rental agency levies a refuel charge because employee didn't refill, submit the rental agency invoice + the rental contract showing return mileage and fuel level. also attach the claimant's card statement or bank charge.
Noor (Events): what if the employee refueled but misplaced the pump receipt?
Lian (Finance): if pump receipt missing, acceptable supporting docs: 1) card statement showing the exact fuel charge at the station (timestamped); 2) photo of the gas pump showing station name/time (if available); OR 3) short attestation describing station, date/time + manager ack. Finance flags amounts over $75 for extra review.
RentalsBot: SYSTEM NOTICE: Rental agreement #R-77531 attached to the agency invoice. Fuel level on return logged as 1/8 tank. Admin refuel fee $55 + toll admin $12.
Avery (People Ops): ok — how strict are we about tolls billed by rental agency vs toll transponder charges on card?
Lian (Finance): if tolls are billed by agency, upload their invoice (agency often charges a toll pass fee plus convenience fee). if billed on your personal card via a transponder, upload the transponder statement or card txn plus toll notice. Either way we need proof of the toll amount and that it was business-related.
Kai (Sales): i once had a personal detour to pick up family on the way back. how do we split?
Lian (Finance): split is required. show mileage or map screenshot of business route vs personal detour, then allocate proportional toll/fuel cost. include a brief note in the expense: "Business miles 120, Personal detour 20 16 business share 86%." manager approval required for the split.
Noor (Events): any guidance on contesting the rental refuel fee? agency charged a punitive rate that seemed wrong.
Lian (Finance): we encourage employees to dispute excess refuel charges with the agency first. document your dispute (email thread) and submit the agency invoice + your dispute evidence. Finance will process reimbursable portion if dispute fails but may request proof you attempted to refuel (e.g., pump receipt or photo).
Avery (People Ops): naming conventions and quick checklist to drop in docs?
Lian (Finance): checklist: upload rental invoice (agency), rental agreement (showing odometer/fuel), merchant gas receipt or card stmt, toll invoice or transponder stmt, short allocation note if mixed, manager approval screenshot. File name examples: `lastname_1745001234_rental_invoice.pdf`, `lastname_1745001234_gas_receipt.jpg`, `lastname_1745001234_toll_invoice.pdf`, `lastname_1745001234_manager_ok.png`.
Avery (People Ops): ExpenseBot reminder please?
RentalsBot: POLICY HIGHLIGHT: Rental refuel charges and tolls are reimbursable when business-related. Preferred proofs: original gas receipt, rental agreement showing fuel on return, rental agency invoice, and card statement. Missing receipts: provide card stmt OR signed attestation + manager approval. Excess punitive refuel fees should be disputed with vendor first.
Kai (Sales): great, submitting now with the rental invoice + bank charge screenshot. thanks! :thumbsup:
